projects.title: HarborForge
projects.short_summary: Actual free-model calibration with frozen tasks and independent verification.
projects.contribution: A terminal-agent evaluation platform with immutable tasks, isolated execution and independent verification.
limits: Three calibration task templates, two attempts per model; not an independent holdout or universal model ranking.
Flint ran on a later date using the same task and harness; output/token stops are unsuccessful completions, not verifier rejections.
Raw calibration task content and model traces remain private; the downloadable repair example is an authored public reference replay.

projects.title: Parametric Modeller
projects.short_summary: Planar CAD feature history with a browser-tested frame edit and actual manufacturing downloads.
projects.contribution: A planar woodworking CAD editor with editable feature history. A local frame example produces saved scenes, cut lists, and SVG/PDF/DXF shop drawings.
limits: One authored square-butt frame with explicit coordinated length/layout editing; no general constraint solver.
Reload begins Untitled; Recent files restores imported scenes while browser local storage is available. Downloaded JSON remains the durable copy.
Independent per-instance metadata overrides and arbitrary instance transforms are outside acceptance.
Desktop 1280x720 and narrow 900x700 tested; mobile and unrelated CAD tools remain unverified.
No hosted interactive app or structural/manufacturing certification is implied.

image.alt: Actual exported shop drawing of the four-board frame example

projects.title: Ghostfolio Agent
projects.short_summary: Typed-tool numerical grounding with a synthetic verification example.
projects.contribution: A portfolio assistant that binds numerical claims to typed tool results, checking the right financial field, entity and currency.
limits: Recorded synthetic controls use zero model calls; live answer quality, browser interaction and multi-user/public hosting are unmeasured.
The source checkout contains unpublished changes; public receipt counts are not a full current-application certification.
